senses.gloss: m. (= h. חֹמֶשׁ, v. Nöld. Mand. Gr. p. 46) the fat around the large stomach of ruminants; בַּר ה׳ the fat covering the less curved side of the large stomach (opinions undecided).
units: <cite ref="Chullin 49b">Ḥull. 49ᵇ</cite> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="H00367"><he>חִי׳</he></cite> a. <cite ref="H00880"><he>בַּר חִי׳</he></cite>).
